mechanism_narrative: Sustained growth in real GDP signals a strong economic expansion that boosts corporate earnings and drives positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward SPX returns are negative in > 40% of months following positive GDP growth.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp rise in the unemployment rate signals a rapidly weakening economy that will drive negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward SPX returns are positive in > 60% of instances when UNRATE rises sharply.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in industrial production signals a weakening supply-side economy that will drive negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward SPX returns are positive in > 50% of months following a decline in industrial production.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp rise in the federal funds rate signals a tightening monetary policy that will drive negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward SPX returns are positive in > 60% of instances when FEDFUNDS rises sharply.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp decline in housing starts signals a weakening consumer sector that will drive negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward SPX returns are positive in > 60% of instances when HOUST declines sharply.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp rise in payroll employment signals a strengthening labor market and consumer spending that will drive positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward SPX returns are negative in > 40% of months following a rise in payroll employment.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp rise in retail sales signals a strengthening consumer sector that will drive positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days, especially if accompanied by a decline in the unemployment rate.
failure_condition: 20-day forward SPX returns are negative in > 50% of instances when RSAFS rises and UNRATE declines.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained rise in the consumer price index signals rising inflation expectations that will drive negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days, especially if accompanied by a rising federal funds rate.
failure_condition: 60-day forward SPX returns are positive in > 50% of instances when CPIAUCSL and FEDFUNDS both rise.
